prompt: I lost a final against Greg Rusedski on grass, who won his 4th career singles title on grass against a player that once defeated me in the opening round of the US Open. I achieved my highest ranking in singles on what date?
answer:
The player was **Mark Philippoussis**. Alexander Popp defeated him in the first round of the 2004 US Open, before losing the 2004 Newport final to Greg Rusedski.

Philippoussis achieved his career-high singles ranking of **No. 8 on March 19, 2001**.
